title: Storytime split-screen: the hornbill lockdown
caption:
The strangest nesting plan in the bird world.

Britannica lists about 60 hornbill species, and in all of them except the two ground hornbills the male walls the female into the nest. Top: southern yellow-billed hornbill, Kalahari.

Source: Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Brainrot demo: nest story in subtitles over a wild hornbill clip, calming kingfisher clip below. Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here.
